result.title: A 3D-Driven Framework for Moving-Camera Perspective-to-360° Video Generation
result.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Project page: https://pano3d-video.github.io/
result.summary: Turning a moving-camera perspective video into a 360° video requires more than just generating content outside the input frame: observations revealed over time must be preserved, unseen regions completed, and the resulting scene kept consistent as the camera viewpoint changes. Existing methods assign these different requirements to a single conditional video model, requiring them to be jointly learned from panoramic video data. We instead present a modular, 3D-driven framework that distributes these three responsibilities across specialized components, all connected through a shared scene representation. Input observations are reconstructed explicitly in 3D, while a pretrained panoramic image model completes unobserved content from a selected panoramic render. This generated content is lifted into the shared 3D scene, where it remains spatially anchored across camera viewpoints. Without requiring any additional panoramic-video training, our framework achieves state-of-the-art input-view fidelity, perceptual quality, and geometric consistency on a static-scene subset of the Argus evaluation set. These results support our decomposed, 3D-driven formulation as a promising alternative to direct video generation in this setting.

AI.brief_summary: 提出模块化、3D 驱动的框架，把移动相机透视视频转 360° 视频的三项需求（保留随时间观测到的内容、补全未见区域、视角变化下保持一致）分配给不同专门组件，并经由共享 3D 场景表示连接，无需全景视频训练即可提升输入视角保真度与几何一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其共享 3D 场景表示在视角变化下持续锚定已观测内容并补全未观测区域，可能为 LVR 中「视觉细节与几何信息是否留在内部状态」以及外部持久状态与 latent 状态的分工提供跨领域线索，可供核查；但该文属视频生成任务，与推理期机制的联系尚属推测。
